issues.desc: background.md Key Insights paragraph references Gate A and Gate B without inline definition on first mention; the expanded descriptions (Gate A = completed-snapshot integrity check, Gate B = done-required suite, Gate C = signed delivery-check) appear only in the later Solution Tradeoffs paragraph. A new reader encountering Key Insights in isolation cannot immediately resolve the letter codes.
